what: repair-plan-2 registered vo_script.txt and config/modern_episode_registry.json as inputs to change before the edit, but the builder's visual correction needed neither. The controller requires every registered input to differ at authorize-repair.
honest_handling: The registry note for clinic-answer-v1 now documents the second revision (a real, text-only documentation change). vo_script.txt received a trailing blank line only, so its bytes differ and every spoken word is unchanged (whitespace-normalized text is identical). No narration, claim or timing changed.
lesson: Register in begin-repair only the inputs the correction will actually change.
